h: Blessing the Month Joins Teshuvah and Peace for Redemption

p: On every Shabbos when the new month is blessed
the seven Musafim of Shabbos and six festivals
as corresponding to the seven shepherds;
the Shabbos Musaf as corresponding to Yosef HaTzaddik.
And this is because there will be two Mashiachs:
in the aspect of "And your people are all righteous" (Yeshayahu 60:21),
and Yosef is a complete tzaddik,
and Mashiach ben David will rectify
one who has had dealings with this;
who raised up the yoke of teshuvah
and David's soul was created for this,
so that if an individual sins,
And Mashiach ben David will be
on whose account forgiveness is granted
meaning that he will instill thoughts of teshuvah
in the heart of Klal Yisrael.
And on the Shabbos before Rosh Chodesh
because the holiness of the days of the week
is contained in the Shabbos before it;
and through the holiness of Shabbos,
And this is the meaning of blessing the month:
that we draw the holiness to the month
"And it shall be, every month on its new moon
and every Shabbos on its Shabbos,
Shabbos is the time to rectify,
that the body be in holiness;
and in the opposite case "flesh of donkeys."
Therefore on Shabbos pleasure is a mitzvah,
since the body too is in holiness.
And the holiness of Rosh Chodesh
the moon, which receives from the sun
הוּא קְדוּשַּׁת דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
is the holiness of David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
who is a chariot for the middah of Malchus,
and David HaMelech, peace be upon him, was created
as they said in the Yerushalmi (chapter 4 of Demai)
on what it says, "And I in my affliction";
and he said, "And my heart is slain within me" (Tehillim 109:22),
for he killed the yetzer hara through fasting.
And on the Shabbos when the month is blessed
And all of Shabbos is also
for which David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
and it is the time to rectify the blemish.
"He swallowed wealth and vomited it up" (Iyov 20:15),
which the holy Ari, of blessed memory, alluded to
in the berachah "Sound the great shofar."
are "those dispersed in the land of Egypt" (Yeshayahu 27:13),
as stated in the holy Zohar
beyond the grasp of our minds,
"The Great One of the worlds was there."
And on the Shabbos when the month is blessed
is the time to rectify this blemish,
the completion of the counting of Yesod,
"He who performed miracles for our fathers, etc.":
that is, although we are not worthy,
"as in the days of your going out of the land of Egypt" (Michah 7:15),
He redeemed them in His kindness
And Shabbos is a time of teshuvah,
"It is good to give thanks to Hashem";
and it is stated (in Pirkei d'Rabbi Eliezer):
'He who confesses and forsakes will be shown mercy.'"
Yisrael are called "those who fear My Name"
and the awe of Shabbos is upon the am ha'aretz
(as they said, Yerushalmi, chapter 4 of Demai);
"'Fortunate is the man who fears Hashem'
fortunate is he who does teshuvah
"The purpose of wisdom is teshuvah, etc.,"
"The beginning of wisdom is the fear of Hashem."
with the holiness of the month,
on the Shabbos when we bless it
and draw the holiness to the month,
שֶׁהוּא קְדוּשַּׁת דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
which is the holiness of David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
who raised up the yoke of teshuvah,
who will instill thoughts of teshuvah
For the exile of the First Temple
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן גָּלוּת בַּיִת שֵׁנִי
which is not so of the exile of the Second Temple,
when they were occupied with Torah
and mitzvos and acts of kindness
at the time they fell into his hand
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה צא, ז)
although he had a claim against them
חֵלֶק א רא, סוֹף עַמּוּד א)
and he will instill his middah
they will merit the redemption soon.
